decisions.decision: App Store Connect app display name is 'Word Puzzle Unlimited' (not 'WordPuzzle', which was taken)
decisions.rationale: Name collision on the App Store; plan's own documented fallback. No code impact.

decisions.decision: Xcode scheme StoreKit Configuration wiring written directly as XML to xcshareddata/xcschemes/WordPuzzle.xcscheme instead of via Edit Scheme GUI
decisions.rationale: No .xcscheme file had ever existed in this repo's history; the implicit-scheme GUI edits were silently not persisting to disk across 3 attempts (2 via Edit Scheme dialog, both apparently unsaved). Direct XML write is deterministic and verifiable; confirmed working via a full test-suite pass.

decisions.decision: Daily streak (RET-01) derived at read time from GameRecord.date over a bounded 400-day window, not stored as a counter, with grace-day semantics
decisions.rationale: Simpler than maintaining a separate mutable counter; avoids drift bugs.

decisions.decision: EntitlementStore derives isPremium exclusively from Transaction.currentEntitlements (no UserDefaults/@AppStorage flag)
decisions.rationale: MON-04 requirement; purchaseUnlimited() and restore() via AppStore.sync() form the frozen API Phase 4's paywall depends on.

decisions.decision: Set up App Store Connect API automation (scripts/appstoreconnect.py, JWT auth via ~/.appstoreconnect/) for future app/IAP record queries and creation
decisions.rationale: Reduces future manual App Store Connect dashboard work; credentials stored outside the repo, machine-wide, reusable across future iOS projects. Read operations tested working; create operations deliberately not yet scripted (verify against Apple's current OpenAPI spec when actually needed).

context_notes: Phase 2 (02-01 through 02-04) is fully complete and merged to main; only 02-05 remains, which finishes Phase 2. This was a full wave-based execute-phase run (3 waves, parallel worktree executors for waves 1-2). Two significant side investigations happened along the way: (1) building App Store Connect API automation (scripts/appstoreconnect.py) since Patrick asked about reducing future manual dashboard work, and (2) an extensive, ultimately inconclusive diagnosis of a local StoreKit-testing environment bug (documented in 02-04-SUMMARY.md and the blocker above) that does not block moving forward. Also worth remembering: this project's Xcode version (26.6) uses PBXFileSystemSynchronizedRootGroup for target folders, so new files in WordPuzzle/WordPuzzle/ or WordPuzzle/WordPuzzleTests/ are automatically part of that target — only a SECOND target membership (like adding WordPuzzle.storekit to WordPuzzleTests) needs explicit wiring.
